issue: frozen perturbation identity mismatch: Agent 1 froze the descendant as a pure function of (base_setup_id, sampler_version, perturbation_seed), but the initial Agent 4 implementation accepted swap_count, max_attempts and profile operator weights as additional result-affecting inputs

old_vs_new_corpus_comparison.method: the complete deterministic setup_stress_corpus_v1 plan was enumerated under the pre-correction code and again under the corrected code; each output's final serialized setup, content fingerprint and class fingerprint were dumped in plan order and compared line by line

resolution.final_identity_semantics: descendant = f(base_setup_id, sampler_version, perturbation_seed) under the frozen setup_perturbation_v1 constants
resolution.max_attempts_status: version constant MAX_PERTURBATION_ATTEMPTS = 64; recorded in provenance as descriptive/integrity metadata; rebuild rejects a record whose value disagrees with the constant
production_perturbation_function_depends: base_setup_id (via the base's canonical arrangement and family)
sampler_version / perturbation_version (frozen constants: operator mix, retry budget, attempt-stream derivation)
perturbation_seed (seed_encoding_v1 composite: swap count in the low 3 bits, raw randomness above)
resolution.sampler_profile_status: sampler decision only (whether to perturb, intensity choice, reflection frequency); once the effective perturbation_seed is emitted the result is profile-independent, and the recorded profile name cannot alter reconstruction
resolution.seed_encoding_rule: perturbation_seed = (raw_seed << 3) | (swap_count - 1); low bits 6 and 7 are invalid
resolution.swap_count_status: derived from perturbation_seed by decode_perturbation_seed; encoded via encode_perturbation_seed; recorded in provenance as derived metadata; rebuild rejects a record whose value disagrees
